description: This file contains unit tests for the ContactsHandler class in an Android application, testing contact search and addition functionalities, permission checks, and responses to various input scenarios.

classes.name: ContactsHandlerTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for the ContactsHandler, testing contact search and add functions, permission requirements, and response handling.

classes.name: FakeContactsDataSource
classes.description: A mock implementation of ContactsDataSource for testing, simulating permission responses and contact data operations.

methods.name: handleContactsSearch_requiresReadPermission
methods.description: Tests that contact search requires read permission and returns an error if permission is not granted.

methods.name: handleContactsAdd_rejectsEmptyContact
methods.description: Tests that adding a contact with empty or invalid data is rejected with an error.

methods.name: handleContactsSearch_returnsContacts
methods.description: Tests successful contact search returning contact data formatted in JSON.

methods.name: handleContactsAdd_returnsAddedContact
methods.description: Tests that adding a contact returns the added contact details and increments call count.
